svg.title: How SinapsiDB works
svg.desc: Six drawings, each one animating in turn. A fact fires when enough of its inputs are active. A query follows a path from a product to its buyers. The journal only appends: a correction names the fact it replaces. Only the blocks a query touches are loaded from disk. An order of 900 euros with 500 of credit left is refused, and the refusal keeps both numbers, so anyone can check later why. A question is a short sentence in SinapsiDB's own language: accendi cliente = Ada e giorno = martedì in fattura leggi fattura.
